text:
Maya Patel: FYI postmortem is up: https://redwood.infra/postmortems/2026-03-hot-slow-path. Recurring p95 latency spikes on the routing layer. I sketched remediation items and a rough timeline in the doc. Can folks claim owners for the follow-ups?
Kevin Zhou: taking ownership of the routing change (item 1). ETA end of next sprint (2 weeks). I want to validate on staging w/ pinned load.
Diego Ramos: I'll own the KVCACHE adjustments (item 2) and the regression test harness. ETA 1 week for the canary and perf tests.
Evelyn Park: I'll update the dashboard and alerting (item 3). Need to know exact SLA thresholds to show and whether to surface error-budget burn rate.
Maya Patel: thanks. SLA targets after incident discussion: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 350ms for text-gen routes; throughput target unchanged. Error budget policy: freeze noncritical deploys at >50% monthly burn. Please reflect that in the dashboard and runbook.
Kevin Zhou: noted. For rollout we'll add a short-circuit fallback to a smaller model variant if latency > 400ms for 20s. Will post PR.
Diego Ramos: quick question — for the KVCACHE TTL changes, do we want per-customer prefixes for larger tenants? That might reduce cross-tenant noise.
Maya Patel: yes, Diego, per-tenant prefixing is preferred. Put that into the design doc section and include perf numbers.
Evelyn Park: tagging the alert rule I plan to change:
```
alert: HighRoutingP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 0.12
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: critical
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/routing-p95
```
I'll add a panel for burn rate and a discrete widget for 'deploy freeze active' with the logic Maya specified.
SRE Oncall Bot: Incident #2026-03-12 created for recurring routing p95 spike — runbook link attached.
Kevin Zhou: quick stat from canary: under pinned load, p95 improved ~18% with small routing change. Sharing graphs in the PR.
Evelyn Park: putting together a dashboard PR. cc @Maya Patel for wording on SLA summary.
Maya Patel: good progress. Diego please schedule a demo of the canary perf next Thu. Evelyn, plan to ship dashboard change + alert tweak by EOD Friday so we can monitor through weekend.
Diego Ramos: scheduled demo for Thu 10am PT.
Evelyn Park: will target EOD Fri and will post the dashboard link here once live.
Maya Patel: final ask — add a recurring check in to the postmortem thread: 2 weeks after fixes go live we'll verify regression, update postmortem with results, and close items.
Kevin Zhou: ack. I'll follow up with a short summary after rollout. :thumbsup:
Evelyn Park: thanks all.
SRE Oncall Bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting in 2 weeks (2026-03-26 17:00 UTC) added to the incident calendar.
